title: kate-core: score a camel-case hump
summary: fuzzy_match adds 8 when a lowercase ASCII letter is followed by an uppercase ASCII letter. A separator bonus stays as it is. The test goes in the existing fuzzy tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: fuzzy.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add camel_bonus. It returns 0 when index is 0. It returns 8 when the previous scalar is an ASCII lowercase letter and the scalar at index is an ASCII uppercase letter. Every other pair returns 0. score_one adds camel_bonus next to boundary_bonus. The underscore bonus stays in boundary_bonus. A hump after an underscore does not get a second 8 from camel_bonus. In foo_bar_scores_the_documented_hits, change the FB and fooBar score from 38 to 46. Leave the fb and foo_bar score at 45. The new test a_camel_hump_adds_eight asserts that FB and fooBar score 46 at positions 0 and 3. fb and foo_bar still score 45 at positions 0 and 4. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: fuzzy::tests::a_camel_hump_adds_eight
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. FB against fooBar scores 38. After the change it scores 46 at positions 0 and 3. fb against foo_bar still scores 45 at positions 0 and 4.
